name: Emanation (Cold)
scaffolding_intent: Emits frost particles around an entity and shifts its tint toward blue, showing that it is cold or frozen

parameters.name: tint
parameters.description: RGB tint shift applied to entity pixels (additive)

parameters.name: tintSaturation
parameters.description: How strongly the tint is applied (0 = no tint, 1 = full tint)

correction_intent: Child described as warm or hot something the scene shows cold or frozen: an object with visible ice, frost, or snow (pond, ice cream, window), or a character shivering, bundled up, or breathing vapor. Target that object or character. Not for heat; that is P2a.
suggestion_intent: An object is visibly frozen or icy, or a character is visibly cold (shivering, bundled up, breathing vapor), and the child mentioned it without saying so. Target that object or character. Requires a visible cue of cold.
